subject: Quick question: can Acme onboard without PO for pilot?
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question: can Acme onboard without PO for pilot?

Hi Ben,

We'd like to kick off a 6-week pilot with Redwood next week. Procurement at Acme normally requires a PO for any vendor, but our internal PO process is still stuck in approvals and will take ~4-6 weeks. Is there a way to get Acme set up on an invoice-only / temporary path so we can start? The pilot is scoped to ~$18k and is time-sensitive for our product launch.

I've attached a short onboarding request and our SOW stub for reference. Happy to provide any vendor docs you need (W-9, insurance, contact).

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Lin
Director, Partnerships
Acme Analytics
[Attachment: Acme_Onboarding_Request.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:02:13 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick question: can Acme onboard without PO for pilot?

Team — forwarding Acme's note. Pilot is ~$18k, start-asap. Acme's procurement is slow; they asked whether we can do a temporary invoice-only onboarding while PO clears.

Proposed approach:
- Approve an "invoice-only" onboarding for up to $25k for 6 weeks with these conditions:
  - Acme provides W-9 + proof of insurance and sign SOW before provisioning
  - Finance (Marissa) issues invoices on net-30; require PO to be submitted within 60 days of first invoice or services paused
  - Risk/IT to confirm no data handling gaps (Karthik, can you confirm security check or request a short risk pack)

Attachments: Acme_Onboarding_Request.pdf (from Acme)

Can we get an exception approval today/tomorrow? If needed I can loop in Laura for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick question: can Acme onboard without PO for pilot?

Thanks for the flag, Ben.

Approve the temporary invoice-only onboarding with the following firm controls:
1) Cap the pilot to $25,000 total gross spend. Any estimate above that requires exec approval.
2) Acme must submit required vendor docs (W-9, COI) and sign the SOW before any provisioning.
3) Finance to set account to "invoice-only" and monitor aging; if PO not received within 60 days of first invoice, services paused and account moved to hold.
4) Karthik — please run a light risk assessment (data types, retention, access controls) and reply to thread by EOD so we have a record.
5) Ben — capture acceptance in our exception form; I've attached the exception_approval_form.pdf template.

Once we have those pieces, Marissa can issue first invoice and ops will provision. This is a one-time exception for pilot velocity; we'll not set a precedent without evidence of PO follow-through.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: exception_approval_form.pdf (pdf, 45KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: can Acme onboard without PO for pilot?

Sarah — good news, we can run the pilot on an invoice-only path with a short exception. High-level summary and next steps: 

What we approved:
- Temporary invoice-only onboarding (one-time exception) up to $25k for a 6-week pilot.
- Redwood will invoice net-30; Acme must submit a PO within 60 days of first invoice or services will be paused.
- Required vendor docs before provisioning: W-9, certificate of insurance (COI), and signed SOW.

What we need from you (ASAP):
1) Complete the vendor_onboarding_form (link below) and return W-9 + COI.
2) Sign the attached SOW and return via DocuSign.

Links & attachments: 
- Vendor onboarding form: https://drive.redwood.com/forms/vendor_onboarding_form_acme (drive link)
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123456789
- Attached: Acme_Onboarding_Request.pdf (from you), exception_approval_form.pdf (our internal record)

Finance (Marissa) will create the invoice-only account once we receive the docs; ops will provision once invoice is created. Karthik, please reply with the risk note so we can include it in the exception file.

If any internal parties at Acme need to be looped in for PO follow-through, please forward and/or copy us. Happy to do a 15-min call if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
